name: teamwork-task-test
description: Fetch a Teamwork.com task or whole tasklist by URL, extract acceptance criteria, and verify each criterion against the current repository — by running existing Pest / PHPUnit / Dusk / Cypress / Playwright / Vitest / Jest / Selenium tests where possible, by driving a real browser via the chrome-devtools MCP for visual checks, and by writing concrete manual scenarios for everything that cannot be automated. Beyond the stated criteria it always reviews four cross-cutting dimensions over the task's own diff — UI/UX and accessibility, performance, security, and page reachability (every registered screen must be reachable by clicking, not only by typing its URL) — plus an advisory fifth, framework best practices (recommendations only: the current idioms of the framework versions the project actually has installed; it never edits code and never fails a criterion), and proves every passing test is load-bearing with a negative control. Outputs a per-task report where each acceptance criterion is marked ✅ verified / ⚠️ partial / ❌ failed / 📋 manual / 📝 proposed, plus a separate findings table for the review dimensions and a short section of framework recommendations. Ticks met criteria to [x] in the Teamwork description under a byte-exact safety contract that preserves inline images; never moves the task or posts comments unless the user opts in. Shares the API token config with the `teamwork-task` plugin so setup is one-time.
